title.narrative: Engaging Danish Youth in Zimbabwean Arts and Resilience

description.narrative: As a part of Operation Dagsværk’s 2024 campaign “Shinga, Be Brave”, our Zimbabwean partners YW and HAA are visiting Denmark. They will join OD’s volunteers on high schools around Denmark and facilitate youth-to-youth workshops around international solidarity. OD annually collects funds on the OD-day in November for international solidarity projects in a national campaign, connecting the everyday on Danish high schools with global issues. This year’s campaign, “Shinga, Be Brave” circulates Zimbabwean the youth organisations YW and HAA, which address mental health through arts and culture. In this regard, the funds from DUF will further ODs work to amplify Zimbabwean voices and engage Danish youth in international issues. This application is to top up a large collaboration between the OD and Dreamtown (Denmark) and YW and HAA (Zimbabwe). Because of that, it does not cover the full tour but rather a part of it.
